# Kyoto Trip Overview: 4 Days for 2 Adults

A relaxed Kyoto plan for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13** that fits your interests: temples, gardens, local food, and moderate walking. I’ve kept early mornings away from the most crowded hotspots and aimed for a **total on-the-ground budget near $2,400** for 2 adults, excluding international flights.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget

## Day 1 — Arrival, Gion, and a Gentle Temple Start
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive in Kyoto, check in, and take a slow lunch near Kyoto Station or Gion.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Kennin-ji** and nearby **Yasaka Shrine** later in the day when crowds thin out.
- **Dinner:** Kyoto-style **yudofu** or a kaiseki-lite set meal in Gion.
- **Rain backup:** **Kyoto National Museum** or **Kyoto Railway Museum** for an easy indoor first day.
- **Transit:** Airport/train arrival → taxi or JR to hotel; use buses/taxis sparingly and walk Gion on foot.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **$430**
  - Hotel: $280
  - Meals: $90
  - Local transit: $20
  - Admissions/snacks: $40

## Day 2 — Eastern Kyoto Gardens and Temple Districts
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Start after the first rush with **Kiyomizu-dera** around mid-morning, then stroll the quieter lanes of Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka.
- **Afternoon:** Head to **Kodai-ji** and the **Maruyama Park** area, then unwind at a tea house or garden.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Head to **Kodai-ji** and the **Maruyama Park** area, then unwind at a tea house or garden, Kyoto, Japan
- **Dinner:** **Obanzai** dinner with seasonal side dishes and tofu specialties.
- **Rain backup:** **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art** or **Nishiki Market** for covered browsing and lunch.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Rain backup:** **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art** or **Nishiki Market** for covered browsing and lunch, Kyoto, Japan
- **Transit:** Walk where possible; use bus/taxi for the hillier temple connections.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **$460**
  - Hotel: $280
  - Meals: $110
  - Local transit: $30
  - Admissions/snacks: $40

## Day 3 — Arashiyama Gardens, Bamboo, and Riverside Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Go to **Arashiyama** after the earliest crowd wave has passed; focus on **Tenryu-ji Garden** and the riverfront.
- **Afternoon:** Add **Okochi Sanso Garden** or a slow walk by the Katsura River; skip over-scheduling so the day stays comfortable.
- **Dinner:** Riverside soba, tofu, or grilled fish set near Arashiyama or back in central Kyoto.
- **Rain backup:** **Saga-Arashiyama area museums** or **Aeon Mall Kyoto Katsuragawa** for indoor shopping and dining.
- **Transit:** JR or Hankyu depending on hotel location; take a taxi for the final short transfer if needed.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **$500**
  - Hotel: $280
  - Meals: $110
  - Transit: $30
  - Admissions/snacks: $80

## Day 4 — Northern Kyoto Temples and a Calm Farewell
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Ninna-ji** or **Ryoan-ji** later in the morning for a quieter pace.
- **Afternoon:** Choose **Kinkaku-ji** only if you’re comfortable with a busier stop, or swap in **Daitoku-ji** for a more peaceful temple experience.
- **Dinner:** Final meal of Kyoto noodles, sushi, or a refined set meal before departure.
- **Rain backup:** **Kyoto Imperial Palace** indoor-adjacent planning with a nearby café stop, or **Kyoto International Manga Museum**.
- **Transit:** Use taxi or a direct bus route to reduce walking and transfer fatigue.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **$390**
  - Hotel: $280
  - Meals: $80
  - Transit: $20
  - Admissions/snacks: $10

# Budget Fit and Best Pacing

| Day | Focus | Transit Style | Estimated Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Gion, Kennin-ji, Yasaka Shrine | Train/taxi mix | $430 |
| Day 2 | Eastern Kyoto temples and gardens | Walk + short bus/taxi | $460 |
| Day 3 | Arashiyama river and gardens | JR/Hankyu + short taxi | $500 |
| Day 4 | Northern Kyoto temples | Bus/taxi | $390 |
| Total | 4 days for 2 adults | Moderate walking | **$1,780** |

- This leaves about **$620 buffer** for nicer dinners, extra taxis, shopping, tea, or a premium experience.
- With your crowd preference, the sweet spot is **late morning to mid-afternoon temple visits** rather than sunrise starts.
